title: Summer Breeze Revival

diffuser.notes: Perfect blend for a refreshing summer evening.

roller.notes: Apply after a warm shower for a cooling sensation.

why_it_works: The uplifting scent of Lemon and Bergamot combines with the soothing properties of Ylang-Ylang to create a revitalizing blend perfect for summer.
safety: Avoid eyes/mucosa; keep from children & pets.
Consult a professional if pregnant, nursing, or under care.
